scientific_role: specification outcome-free cross-person alignment of local state centroids and continuous three-epoch trajectory geometry before any report/context mapping

allowed_primary_inputs: continuous_trajectories restricted to identifiers and six invariant geometry columns

stable_discrete_state_branch.population: participants with a latent_state_fit-stable discrete solution only
stable_discrete_state_branch.missing_state_rule: participants without stable discrete states contribute no pseudo-state and are never forced into this branch
stable_discrete_state_branch.participant_balance: state sample weights equal prespecified within-participant state proportions; weights sum to one within every participant
preprocessing: require finite fixed common-axis centroid values for every retained cell
compute participant-balanced weighted median and weighted IQR separately for each common-axis cell
drop a cell only if weighted IQR <= 1e-08
fit participant-weighted PCA with at most 8 components
orient every component deterministically so its largest-absolute loading is positive

alignment_model.distance: squared Euclidean distance in prespecified aligned-state PCA space
alignment_model.within_participant_constraint: injective Hungarian assignment: two local states from the same participant cannot map to the same shared family
alignment_model.canonical_family_label_rule: sort final prototypes lexicographically by deterministically oriented aligned-state PC1, then PC2, etc.

stability.entire_chain_refit: weighted robust scaling, weighted PCA, and constrained alignment are all refit inside every resample
stability.comparison: adjusted Rand index on retained local-state objects against full-fit assignments
stability.selection_rule: among eligible family counts, choose the smallest count with participant-weighted silhouette >= maximum eligible silhouette - 0.05
stability.no_eligible_count_rule: do not force shared discrete state families; retain the continuous aligned-state embedding and pairwise distances only

stable_discrete_state_branch.leave_one_participant_out_diagnostic: refit on all other stable participants, assign held-out local states injectively, and report assignment margins/agreement; never revise family-count selection

continuous_trajectory_geometry_branch.population: all latent_state_fit-eligible participants, including continuous-only participants
continuous_trajectory_geometry_branch.participant_balance: each trial has weight 1 divided by that participant trial count; weights sum to one within every participant
preprocessing: within each participant, median-center and divide by IQR for each geometry feature
if within-participant IQR <= 1e-08, use pooled participant-balanced IQR for that feature

alignment_model.distance: squared Euclidean distance in the six prespecified standardized geometry coordinates
alignment_model.canonical_family_label_rule: sort final centroids lexicographically in the prespecified geometry-feature order

stability.entire_chain_refit: transform fallback statistics, within-person scaling, and weighted k-means are all refit inside every resample
stability.comparison: adjusted Rand index on retained trajectories against full-fit assignments
stability.selection_rule: among eligible family counts, choose the smallest count with participant-weighted silhouette >= maximum eligible silhouette - 0.05
stability.no_eligible_count_rule: do not force trajectory families; retain the six-dimensional continuous geometry representation

continuous_trajectory_geometry_branch.leave_one_participant_out_diagnostic: fit on all other participants, assign held-out trajectories to prespecified training centroids, and report confidence/occupancy; never revise family-count selection

outcome_free_linkage_after_both_branches.eligible_rows: discrete trajectories belonging to participants with stable local states
outcome_free_linkage_after_both_branches.global_path: replace each local state by its prespecified shared state-family assignment when available
outcome_free_linkage_after_both_branches.cross_branch_summary: cross-tabulate shared state-family paths against shared continuous-trajectory families
outcome_free_linkage_after_both_branches.null_scheme: within participant, permute continuous-trajectory family labels across trials while preserving local/global path frequencies
outcome_free_linkage_after_both_branches.failure_rule: if either branch has no stable discrete family solution, omit discrete cross-branch linkage and retain both continuous outputs

execution_order_and_locks: verify every latent_state_fit primary hash before reading alignment inputs
fit and write both outcome-free alignment branches
write selected family counts, embeddings, assignments, prototypes, stability, and leave-one-participant-out diagnostics
SHA-256 lock all alignment outputs before any context/report table may be opened
perform only the prespecified outcome-free cross-branch linkage after both branch locks
claim_guardrails: a shared family is a reproducible alignment of this representation, not a universal emotion or valence category
absence of stable shared families does not imply absence of individual neurophysiological structure
participant identity, epoch association, or context separability is not emotion decoding
continuous-only participants remain represented through invariant trajectory geometry without fabricated states
report/context mapping is strictly post-hoc and begins only after cross_person_alignment_fit outputs are hashed
forbidden: reading valence, liking, arousal, emotion reports, labels, context, or report-derived factors during cross_person_alignment_design or cross_person_alignment_fit
using QC values, epoch family, stimulus identity, participant identity targets, or prior decoding performance as alignment features
changing latent_state_fit local K, local assignments, centroids, trajectories, or participant inclusion
selecting shared-family counts from later report/context association
